title_zh: 百度：从搜索到人工智能
title_en: Chinese Companies (7/20): Baidu, from Search to AI
note_en: 于 (yú) is a formal, written-style preposition meaning "in, at, on, to." In 专注于中文搜索技术 "focusing on Chinese-language search technology," it links the verb 专注 "focus" to its object, the way "on" does in English. You'll meet it constantly in business and news writing (毕业于北京大学 "graduated from Peking University"), but in speech people usually use 在 instead.
